summary: Alterity Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K on June 3, 2026, solely to announce a change in registered office address to Level 15, 500 Collins Street, Melbourne, effective immediately. No securities offering, merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or any other special-situations transaction is involved. This is a routine corporate notification under ASX Listing Rule 3.14 and is not a reportable special event under US securities law.
